parallelism: Three arms per data order; disjoint8logical-core groups0–7/8–15/16–23,two physical chips each. Second data order follows first terminal models.

source_originals.scope: New private RAM originals survive process failures but are volatile across node restart. No old state or compilation cache is removed.

EBS.model_format: Lossless zstd archive with complete uncompressed SHA readback
EBS.full_optimizer_retention: One rotating latest full archive for this study; preserve prior full archive until successor member-by-member readback/fsync. All original full states remain in RAM.
EBS.intermediate_model_backups: Latest per-run model can replace an older backup copy after new readback; all original checkpoint models remain.
EBS.scope: Same-instance EBS protects all terminal model weights and the latest full recovery state,not every optimizer history and not an off-instance replica.
EBS.minimum_before_backup: 35GiB floor + complete uncompressed payload size + possible model staging +1GiB; writers serialized. No archive producer starts unless that fits.
EBS.before_terminal_continuation: Finish planned backup-only lossless model archival; preserve qualified full checkpoint and source originals. Recheck measured peak space for each wave; no projected compression result is called an existing backup.
EBS.compiler_interaction: Do not overlap large EBS archive writes with new accelerator compilation; first64 stages physically close before backup rotation.

retention_transition: After verified science64 full archive,older disposable qualification full archive may become model+evidence-only EBS backup. Its original full RAM4/8 remain. Record every backup-only retirement explicitly; never claim protocols interchangeable.
release_scope: This plan alone launches nothing. Explicit scoped stage64 release and review still required; terminal continuation requires all3 actual64 native/order/update/full-state/host-memory audits and protected checkpoint evidence.
